card.text: Potato-shaped moon that shepherds the inner edge of Saturn's F ring.

introduction.text: Prometheus is probably a porous, icy body. The Voyager 1 team discovered it in 1980.

normal.title: ISS mosaic
normal.summary: Brightness matching reduces shading from the photographs; shadowed terrain is left empty.

filter-color.title: Cassini false color
filter-color.summary: Measured filter bands in false color, not human-visible color. Photographed shadows remain.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height above or below a 43.1 km sphere from the Cassini shape; small craters are not resolved.
